model.description: Experience the premium quality of In House with the Biscotti 1G Dispo, a convenient all-in-one cartridge delivering exceptional flavor and potency in every draw. This 1g disposable vape captures the essence of the beloved Biscotti strain, known for its rich, dessert-like profile featuring sweet, buttery notes with hints of nuttiness and spice. The sleek, portable design requires no charging or setup—simply inhale and enjoy smooth, satisfying vapor wherever life takes you. Perfect for both seasoned enthusiasts and newcomers seeking hassle-free convenience, this disposable cartridge offers consistent performance from first puff to last. In House brings you strain-specific quality in a user-friendly format that fits seamlessly into your lifestyle. Whether you're relaxing at home or on the go, the Biscotti 1G Dispo delivers authentic cannabis flavor and effects in one compact, ready-to-use device.
